description: This file defines an enum named SignificantLocationMonitor that monitors significant location changes on iOS devices. It starts monitoring based on certain location authorization conditions and sends location update events to a gateway when location changes occur.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes monitoring for significant location changes if the location mode is set to always and the app has proper authorization. When a location change is detected, it encodes the location into JSON and sends an event via the gateway.
